summary: Assignment and tenancy boundaries are enforced through authentication middleware and explicit role separation. The API middleware validates sessions and fails closed. The frontend proxy enforces auth boundaries. The admin page (frontend/app/admin/page.tsx) provides administrative functions separate from customer dashboard. Provider dashboard exists for care providers. The groups feature (frontend/app/groups/) enables provider grouping by criteria. The directory access token test (frontend/lib/directory-access-token.test.ts) verifies scoped access. Multi-tenancy is implicit in the Vercel deployment architecture (separate frontend/backend services).
assertions: API middleware session validation fails closed
Admin, customer dashboard, and provider dashboard as separate routes
Directory access token with scoped permissions (directory-access-token.test.ts)
Vercel multi-service architecture with separate frontend/backend boundaries
